t: The Luceco Prysm Outdoor LED Solar Wall Light provides efficient and automatic illumination for domestic external areas. It is ideal for enhancing security around driveways, pathways, and garden spaces. Featuring an integrated PIR sensor with an 8m detection range and a 110-degree angle, this solar-powered unit ensures reliable motion-triggered lighting. A high-quality monocrystalline solar panel charges the internal battery, complemented by a USB recharging option for consistent power. This IP54-rated black wall light includes a back amber night light for subtle ambient illumination and smart power management for extended operation. Fixings are supplied for straightforward wall-mounted installation.
